infotypes.name: home_page

infotypes.name: dashboard
infotypes.description: Personal dashboard home for a signed-in user.

infotypes.description: A list of projects in either the user's dashboard, the public explore area, a namespace, or as a curated/feed view.

infotypes.name: group_list
infotypes.description: A list of groups in a personal dashboard or public explore area.

infotypes.name: milestone_list
infotypes.description: A list of milestones, such as milestones on the dashboard or within a project section.

infotypes.name: snippet_list
infotypes.description: A list of code snippets in the dashboard or explore area.

infotypes.name: activity_feed
infotypes.description: Activity stream for the dashboard, a project, or a namespace feed.

infotypes.name: todo_list
infotypes.description: Personal todo items list.

infotypes.name: explore_home
infotypes.description: Top-level explore landing page.

infotypes.name: topic_list
infotypes.description: A list of project topics in the explore area.

infotypes.name: search_results
infotypes.description: Search results scoped globally or to a project/group.

infotypes.name: project_creation_form
infotypes.description: Form to create a new project.

infotypes.name: group_creation_form
infotypes.description: Form to create a new group.

infotypes.name: snippet_creation_form
infotypes.description: Form to create a new snippet, either globally or inside a project.

infotypes.name: help_page
infotypes.description: Help landing page or a specific documentation page.

infotypes.name: import_history
infotypes.description: History of previous imports.

infotypes.name: import_creation_form
infotypes.description: Form to start a new import from an external provider.

infotypes.name: profile_page
infotypes.description: User profile root or one of its settings/profile sections.

infotypes.name: namespace_page
infotypes.description: Overview page for a namespace such as a user or group space.

infotypes.name: user_tab
infotypes.description: A specific user profile tab page.

infotypes.name: project_page
infotypes.description: Project overview page or a generic project section page.

infotypes.name: starrer_list
infotypes.description: List of users who starred a project.

infotypes.name: fork_list
infotypes.description: List of forks of a project.

infotypes.name: issue_detail
infotypes.description: Detail page for a specific issue.

infotypes.name: merge_request_detail
infotypes.description: Detail page for a specific merge request.

infotypes.name: pipeline_detail
infotypes.description: Detail page for a specific pipeline run.

infotypes.name: milestone_detail
infotypes.description: Detail page for a specific milestone in a project.

infotypes.description: List of labels in a project.

infotypes.name: project_member_list
infotypes.description: List of members of a project.
